checks: An explicit connection click obtains a fake browser track; no test starts automatically.
EN/RU ready screenshots at desktop, short desktop, 390, 767 and 768 confirm shared 32/40/44 desktop roles and 48px phone targets.
Injected denied connection omits the initial waiting sentence in EN/RU, blocks Continue, then an explicit retry restores readiness.
A synthetic ended event on the fake track disables Continue and asks for reconnection in EN/RU.
Missing MediaRecorder produces localized browser-capability copy; the fake live connection and optional Continue readiness remain available.
limitations: No physical microphone or speakers were used.

Injected failure states prove this UI handling only; the recoverable media-invalid test error is covered by the focused unit test, not a browser fault capture. These checks do not establish native permission UI, physical-device behavior, browser support policy, OS contention, a real phone, screen-reader, forced-colors, native zoom, provider, backend, or production behavior.
Only the focused MicrophoneScreen unit test file was run; no full suite, typecheck, or build was run during concurrent writers.
